title: Reagan-era release of Falcon and Condor in UFO Cover-Up Live

tellings.quote: the story was Reagan allowed the the whole thing about the Falcon and the Condor to come out and the alien at Wright Patterson Air Force Base.

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, describes a story from around 1988 and 1989. He says Ronald Reagan, the US president of the 1980s, allowed material to come out about two insiders known as the Falcon and the Condor, and about an alien said to be held at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, a US Air Force base in Ohio. Cameron ties this to a television program called UFO Cover-Up Live and gives no other source; if true, it would mean a president quietly let secrets about aliens reach the public.
